item.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to 60,000 Employees Across AI and Core Units
item.description:
Microsoft has launched a voluntary buyout program for up to 60,000 employees in the US, UK, Canada, and India to avoid further layoffs. The initiative covers key divisions including Copilot, CoreAI, and Windows, signaling a strategic workforce restructuring amid the ongoing AI transition.

原文标题：微软向 6 万员工提供自愿买断 涵盖 AI 与核心业务部门

Why it matters：涉及全球最大科技公司之一的大规模人员结构调整，直接反映 AI 产业扩张期的成本压力与组织变革趋势。

item.title: Sebastian Raschka Releases Video Course on Building Reasoning Models from Scratch
item.description:
AI expert Sebastian Raschka released an accompanying video course titled 'Build a Reasoning Model (From Scratch)', featuring 11 hours of content. The course uses PyTorch to demonstrate core techniques such as inference scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, aiming to help developers deeply understand the implementation details of LLM reasoning mechanisms.

原文标题：Raschka 发布推理模型从零构建视频课

Why it matters：对于希望掌握大模型推理底层实现而非仅调用 API 的高级开发者具有极高的学习价值。

item.title: Everything Project Open-Sources MIT-Licensed Alternatives to Major Software
item.description:
The Everything Project has open-sourced its effort to rebuild and provide free, MIT-licensed alternatives to proprietary software like Office, Slack, Photoshop, and AutoCAD. Hosted as a monorepo, the project allows developers to clone and run applications locally using Node.js 22.12 or newer.

原文标题：Everything 项目开源 复刻 Office 等主流软件

Why it matters：大规模开源替代方案对开发者生态具有显著吸引力，且提供了可直接运行的代码库。

item.title: Anthropic Files for Nasdaq IPO: H1 Revenue Hits $16.3B as Compute Costs Drop to 48%
item.description:
Anthropic has officially filed its S-1 registration statement with the SEC, planning a Nasdaq IPO under the ticker 'ANT'. The filing reveals explosive revenue growth ($16.3B in H1 2026) and operational profitability, driven by compute costs dropping from 250% to 48% of revenue. While accounting losses stem from convertible note revaluations, the company maintains strong cash reserves and disclosed massive long-term compute procurement contracts with vendors like Broadcom and SpaceXAI.

原文标题：Anthropic 递交 IPO 招股书：上半年营收 163 亿 算力成本占比降至 48%

Why it matters：头部 AI 实验室首次公开财务细节，揭示算力成本优化对盈利的决定性影响及巨额基础设施投入规模。

item.title: Meta Plans $95B Stock Sale to Fund Massive AI Infrastructure Buildout
item.description:
Meta has announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through new stock and preferred share offerings to fund its massive AI infrastructure expansion. The financing structure includes Class A common stock, convertible preferred shares, and future sales of non-voting Class C shares, designed to secure capital without diluting CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control. Chip giants Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom have expressed non-binding interest in purchasing up to $5 billion of Meta stock.

原文标题：Meta 拟售股募资 950 亿美元加速 AI 基建

Why it matters：该事件标志着超大规模科技公司为应对 AI 算力需求而进行的史上最大规模之一股权融资，直接反映行业资本流向与算力军备竞赛现状。

item.title: Tencent Open-Sources Hy-SimulMT: 3s Latency Beats Human Interpreters
item.description:
Tencent has open-sourced Hy-SimulMT, a simultaneous interpretation LLM supporting real-time Chinese-English speech-to-speech translation with voice cloning. With a latency of ~3 seconds, it outperforms the average human interpreter and matches or exceeds expert-level translation quality. The model is now available for free via the Tencent Hy Translation app.

原文标题：腾讯开源 Hy-SimulMT 同传大模型 3 秒响应超人类译员

Why it matters：开源同传模型在延迟和质量上双双超越人类专家基准，具备极高的工程落地价值和技术参考意义。

item.title: vLLM Achieves 100% Tool-Call Accuracy via Constrained Decoding
item.description:

This feature enforces schema adherence, boosting the accuracy of models like Kimi K2.6 from 92% to 100%, thereby significantly enhancing the reliability of agentic workflows.

原文标题：vLLM 启用约束解码 将工具调用准确率提至 100%
